description: Defer colors.py _load_theme from module level to first COLOR attribute access

asi.hypothesis: colors.py calls _load_theme() and _theme_context() at module level, which walks the filesystem (~52ms in isolation). Deferring to first COLOR attribute access via _ColorMeta.__getattribute__ avoids this cost during startup.
asi.result: Small but real improvement (~1.6%). The colors import overlaps with other startup imports so the absolute savings is smaller than the isolated 52ms measurement.

description: Lazy import get_config and importlib.util in command_service

asi.hypothesis: command_service imports get_config from manager at module level, pulling in importlib.metadata/util and tomllib. Deferring to a wrapper function and moving importlib.util to _import_file avoids this during startup.
asi.result: ~1ms improvement. Manager imports are now deferred until command loading actually runs.

description: Defer importlib.metadata from manager.py module level + lazy tomllib/importlib.util in colors.py

asi.hypothesis: importlib.metadata (18ms) was being imported at module level in both colors.py and manager.py. Moving to local imports in the functions that need it defers this cost.
asi.result: ~2.3ms improvement on primary. importlib.metadata is now imported lazily from manager.py._get_console_script_aliases when config discovery hits non-matching configs.

description: Defer shutil import from __init__.py module level to run_app version callback

asi.hypothesis: shutil (3.8ms) was imported at module level but only used in run_app version callback. Deferring saves startup time.
asi.result: ~1.4ms improvement on primary. shutil is now only imported when --version is passed.
